name: Record episode
description: Save a concrete past experience (tried / error / fix / outcome) into episodic memory.

function.name: record_episode
function.description: Persist one concrete episode: what was tried, in what context, what failed, how it was fixed, and the outcome. Use for real experiences (e.g. deploy X on project Y hit error Z, fixed with A, succeeded). Not for general prefs (use memory) or abstract facts (use remember).

summary.description: Optional full narrative; auto-built from fields if omitted.
